convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMACD indicator, simple crossover signal logic, deposit-fraction position sizing, no external libraries, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale/pending order complexity

derived_values.name: Lot size from deposit fraction
derived_values.formula: Risk * Money / Deposit, clamped between SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN and SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT

other_exits: Signal reversal implicitly closes opposite position by reversing (volume adjustment adds to opposite side); SL disabled by default (SL=0)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lots = Risk * (Deposit + closed_profit + floating_P/L) / Deposit; if existing position same direction: volume -= existing_volume (add to position); if opposite direction: volume += existing_volume (reverse position); volume reduced by SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP on margin failure

custom_logic_notes: Entry has two signal types per direction: (1) MACD histogram crosses zero (bar[1] vs bar[0] sign change), (2) MACD signal line local extremum while histogram stays same sign (Sig[0]<Sig[1]>Sig[2] for short, Sig[0]>Sig[1]<Sig[2] for long). Position reversal logic: if a position exists in opposite direction, the new volume is ADDED to existing volume (net reversal). If same direction, volume difference is sent (adding to position). The CopyBuffer retry mechanism uses Recount flag to re-fetch indicator data on failure. OrderSend retries up to 10 times with volume reduction on margin failure and Sleep on rate-limit/connection errors.
python_conversion_notes: MACD with non-standard periods (30/500/36) - not typical 12/26/9. Signal reversal adds existing position volume to new order volume for net reversal effect. The Money_M function simulates compounding by tracking all historical deal profits against initial Deposit. SL default is 0 (disabled), TP is 2200 points. The zero-line crossover uses histogram values from bars [1] and [0] (previous completed bar vs bar before that). The signal-line peak/trough detection uses 3 consecutive signal values [1],[2],[3] shifted by 1 bar. No digit adjustment needed since TP/SL use _Point directly.
